tests.name: Provider-neutral capability vocabulary and constraints are strictly enforced
CapabilityProfile validation accepts valid declarations and rejects malformed inputs
Manifest parser and serializer round-trip deterministically without secrets
CapabilityObservation validates state, provenance, quota, and timestamps
Per-capability state evaluation handles AVAILABLE, QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, STALE, and MISSING independently
Per-capability isolation: Degradation of one capability leaves other capabilities intact
Economic admission rejects unauthorized paid tiers and enforces explicit free policy
Hard Invariant: Paid fallback is PROHIBITED when free quota is exhausted
Manual/Free Fallback: Free manual capability route succeeds when remote provider is exhausted or down
CapabilityRegistry integration registers research capabilities and routes deterministically
Canonical Authority Isolation: Capability state mutations NEVER alter ResearchDocument corpus
Baseline suite executes completely offline with zero credentials or network
Baseline capability manifests in config/research-capabilities load cleanly
